$comment: The curated publication set for registry/registry.json — which built-in plugins appear in the free git-PR-index catalog feed. This file is the ONLY hand-maintained half: the entry BODIES (name/version/description/kinds/grants/tags/requires/targets) are projected from each plugin's manifest by tools/generate-registry.mjs, so a manifest change can never drift from the published catalog again. Adding a plugin to the feed = add its id here and regenerate; it is a data edit, never a code edit.
